title: Civil Drafter (Req 100049)
content_text:

Melbourne, Victoria, AU

Requisition ID:  100049
Job Category:  Engineering
Location:  Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining , energy , and infrastructure , our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally.
Our Project Delivery Group (PDG) is a dynamic team of professionals passionately committed to world-class  project delivery  across the globe. With expertise in sustainable studies, asset building and operations, and industry-leading efficiencies, our best-in-class team leverages methodologies, governance and systems that are unparalleled in the  engineering  space. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you.
Our Civil Engineering team delivers a broad range of services across transport infrastructure projects, including site selection and planning, earthworks site grading, drainage modelling, spatial and digital terrain modelling, and flood impact assessments. Working closely with our wider Earth Sciences capability, the team supports projects across road and rail environments. We are looking to expand our team and welcome an experienced  Civil Drafter  to support project delivery .  In this role, you will be responsible for the production and management of high-quality civil design drawings across multiple project phases. You will work closely with designers, engineers, and project teams to ensure drawings meet client, authority, and quality standards while contributing to the safe and efficient delivery of transport infrastructure projects.
Key Responsibilities
Produce high-quality civil drawings using AutoCAD across detailed design, construction, and as‑built phases
Prepare and issue drawing and PDF sets in accordance with project and client requirements
Support drawing document control, including file management, uploads/downloads, and drawing registers
Maintain drawing databases and standard detail libraries
Work collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams
Liaise with the CAD Manager, Lead Civil Designer, engineers, and junior staff
Ensure drawings comply with relevant standards, authority requirements, and quality procedures
Demonstrate a strong commitment to quality assurance, safety, and timely project delivery
About You
You will bring prior experience in a civil drafting role, with strong proficiency in  AutoCAD  and a solid understanding of civil infrastructure deliverables. Experience with  MicroStation, OpenRoads, or Civil 3D  is advantageous but not essential. You hold an  Associate Diploma in Civil Engineering  or an equivalent relevant qualification from a recognised tertiary institution. Knowledge of road and rail authority standards is important, with  TMR experience highly regarded . You take pride in your work, demonstrate high personal safety standards, and approach tasks with integrity, professionalism, and a customer-focused mindset. You enjoy working in small, collaborative teams, communicate effectively, and are well organised, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and work with minimal supervision.
Why join us?
Work with great people to make a difference
Collaborate on exciting projects to develop innovative solutions
Top employer
What we offer you?
Global project exposure across complex, impactful industries
Strong focus on career growth, learning and mentorship
Collaborative, values-driven culture focused on innovation and excellence
Don't meet every single requirement? You don't need to. At Hatch, we are building a diverse, inclusive workplace that fosters innovation. If you're interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if your past experiences don't perfectly align with the skills we've listed.
Hatch holds an innovate reconciliation action plan and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Straight islanders to apply. As an accredited Employer of Choice for Gender Equality (WGEA) and Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering a workforce in each of our locations that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Within Australia, this includes supporting and encouraging a collaborative workplace and a comprehensive benefit offering. If you have any special needs requirements, please discuss with us and we will do our utmost to accommodate your request. We are managing this recruitment process directly and are not accepting unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies.
